draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Glad to hear the first week is going well -- the layout clicks pretty quickly once a few people are working in the same place. Your bulk import question is closed on our side, so shout if anything there still feels rough.

Since you mentioned team size: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them. Happy to hop on a short call this week to get your team into Bright Partners' project and put real work in front of them.

Best,
Chidi
